sources.entry: NoteTaker - Simple note taking app for macOS and iOS which uses Realm and CloudKit for syncing.

summary.one_liner: NoteTaker is a sample note-taking app for macOS and iOS that uses Realm and CloudKit to sync notes between devices.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes NoteTaker as a simple note taking app for macOS and iOS that syncs using Realm and CloudKit. It is presented as a sample project demonstrating a syncing architecture described in the author's article on CloudKit. The iOS version only lists notes and exists to show syncing between devices and platforms. The README gives build instructions: install Carthage, run carthage update to fetch dependencies, then open the project in Xcode. It does not describe other features in detail.
use_cases: reference for syncing Realm data with CloudKit
sample macOS and iOS notes app
studying cross-platform note syncing between Mac and iPhone
how_to_run: Run `carthage update` in the project directory (can take several minutes, only needed once)
Open the project in Xcode and build it with an Apple Developer account
notable: Demonstrates an architecture for syncing with Realm and CloudKit
Companion to the author's CloudKit article
iOS app is a list-only viewer meant to show cross-device sync
caveats: The iOS version only lists notes and is provided for demonstration
Building requires an Apple Developer account
Targets Xcode 8.2.1, which is an old toolchain
